from toyapp.catalog import browse, browse_next
from toyapp.pagination import CursorPage


def test_direct_catalog_page():
    assert browse(["a", "b", "c"], page=2, per_page=2).items == ["c"]


def test_catalog_next_page_walks_forward():
    first = browse_next(["a", "b", "c"], per_page=2)
    assert isinstance(first, CursorPage)
    assert first.items == ["a", "b"]
    assert first.has_more
    second = browse_next(["a", "b", "c"], first.next_cursor, per_page=2)
    assert second.items == ["c"]
    assert second.next_cursor is None
    assert not second.has_more
